nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What percentage of revenue share did the air quality/clean energy segment represent among the top 20 environmental firms in 2022?
nodes.answer: The air quality/clean energy segment represented 79.4% of the revenue share among the top 20 environmental firms in 2022.

nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What methodology does the study use to analyze air quality and pollution hotspots?
nodes.answer: The study analyzes air quality data in conjunction with mapping pollution hotspots, particularly considering the exacerbating effects of heatwaves.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Smart cities|Air quality monitoring|Air quality analytics_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What methodology was used in the study to analyze the aerosol composition at the single-particle level?
nodes.answer: The study employed a single-particle mass spectrometer that detects and profiles individual particles by using laser pulses for ion formation, providing insights into the chemical composition relevant to environmental and health effects.
